 The 
following Special Considerations box describes respiratory changes that occur with aging. Respiratory changes in 
older adults can be related to normal aging or respiratory disease. Age-related changes in the muscles and the 
cardiovascular system may also cause abnormal respirations (Schneider et al., 2021). 
SPECIAL CONSIDERATIONS 
Age-Related Changes in the Respiratory System 
As individuals age, changes to the musculoskeletal, vascular, and respiratory systems that alter function and 
may require nursing interventions, as outlined in Table 13.1.
